findings.claim: 10-K 列出主要對手為 Sumitomo、JX、Freiberger、Umicore、CCTC、Vital Materials；稱競爭強度過去幾年增加、預期持續增加，競爭壓力已造成價格下降，可能壓縮份額與毛利。
findings.excerpt: The level and intensity of competition has increased over the past years and we expect competition to continue to increase in the future. Competitive pressures have resulted in reductions in the prices of our products, and continued or increased competition could reduce our market share, require us to further reduce the prices of our products, affect our ability to recover costs and result in reduced gross margins and profitability.

findings.claim: 10-K 稱客戶通常至少有兩家合格基板供應商；InP 與低 EPD GaAs 競爭者較少，品質為關鍵因素。

findings.excerpt: We perform ongoing credit evaluations of our customers’ financial condition, and limit the amount of credit extended when deemed necessary, but generally do not require collateral. One customer accounted for more than 10% of our accounts receivable as of December 31, 2025 and 2024.

findings.claim: 風險因素：客戶無義務採購特定數量，可減少、延後或取消訂單；過去曾遇訂單推遲與取消。
findings.excerpt: Our customers are not obligated to purchase a specified quantity of our products or to provide us with binding forecasts of product purchases.
